procedure: Verify supplied/reference artifact bytes and historical review scope.
Map all current content to the requested design.
Identify actual renderer capability or explicit unresolved implementation.
Define and, only when tools exist, execute bound content-retention and page checks.

acceptance.expectation: Existing selected PDF and historical review hashes match before reference reuse.
Historical presentation selection is not current financial approval or new artifact review.
Every content binding has a presentation destination; clipping, glyphs, tables, charts and notes require actual page checks.
Absent build/render helpers remain explicitly unavailable; no format capability is invented.

conditions: Required input unavailable or hash/version stale
Acceptance is failed or not performed
failure.record: failure_records with affected record, missing evidence/test, consequence, owner, next action and interim conclusion restriction
